name: Emenski Canyon Run
description: Emenski Canyon Run 2026 is a mountain running event held in the village of Emen, Veliko Tarnovo Province. The race offers three courses of varying distance and elevation gain: 8 km with 360 m of positive elevation gain, 16 km with 720 m, and 24 km with 1,100 m. Participants can enjoy marked trails, aid stations, and professional timing. The event includes a medal and souvenir for all finishers, as well as race photos.
course_highlights: Three courses of 8 km, 16 km, and 24 km
Mountain terrain with 360 to 1,100 metres of positive elevation gain
Marked trails and aid stations along the route
additional: Registration and race-pack collection from 08:00 to 11:00. Technical briefing at 10:20 at the start. Starts: 24 km at 10:30, 16 km at 11:00, and 8 km at 11:45. A medal and souvenir for all finishers. Timing and a race bib for all participants. Race photography. Trail running across different distances, registration, medals, aid stations, and technical information for participants.

name: Маратон Бургас
price_range: от 10 до 50 EUR в зависимост от избраната дистанцията и периода
description:
Burgas Marathon 2026 awaits you on November 15 for an unforgettable run!

Whether you’re chasing a new personal best, preparing for your first half marathon, or simply want to share the excitement of sport with your family and friends, Burgas Marathon offers a distance for everyone.

Choose your challenge:

42.195 km Marathon | 21.097 km Half Marathon | 10.5 km | 5 km |
1 km Decathlon Fun Run – for children, families, and everyone who wants to be part of the running celebration

The course runs along the sea and past iconic locations in Burgas, combining a fast route, beautiful views, and an incredible atmosphere. Participants from Bulgaria and abroad, dozens of volunteers, music, support along the course, and that unforgettable feeling when you cross the finish line await you.

Choose your distance, register, and become part of the event that brings people together through sport, movement, and a love of an active lifestyle.

Burgas Marathon – Run with the pulse of Burgas!

name: XL kmrun - Бонсови поляни
description: XL kmrun – Bonsovi Polyani is a November race in the XLkmrun calendar, organized by 5kmrun. It takes place in the Lyulin Mountain area and the iconic Bonsovi Polyani locality on the outskirts of Sofia. Participants can choose between three distances—short, medium, and long—allowing runners with different levels of preparation and ambitions to take part. The event is part of a series of races offering varied courses and running conditions in the natural surroundings of Sofia.
course_highlights: The course passes through the Lyulin Mountain area and the Bonsovi Polyani locality
A choice of three distances—short, medium, and long
A natural, iconic location on the outskirts of Sofia
additional: The race will take place in a natural setting with mountainous terrain; registration details and fees have not been specified. The date is November 22, 2026.

name: XL kmrun - Северен парк
description: XL kmrun - North Park is a race on the 5kmrun calendar, held in North Park, Sofia. Participants can choose between three distances—6 km, 12 km, and 18 km—suitable for different levels of fitness. The event offers the opportunity to run in a natural setting on varied terrain and is part of the XLkmrun series of races held at various locations around Sofia. It is a traditional winter race that attracts runners from the city and the surrounding region.
course_highlights: Three distances: 6 km, 12 km, and 18 km
Terrain with alternating climbs and descents
Held in North Park, Sofia
additional: The distances allow participants to choose according to their abilities and preferred level of exertion. The race is part of the XLkmrun winter calendar and takes place in conditions suitable for winter running.

name: Витоша Ски и Дъски
location: Aleko Hut, Vitosha Nature Park, Sofia, Bulgaria
description: Vitosha Ski and Board is an event organized by the Sofia Mountain Club Association, held in Vitosha Nature Park, around Aleko Hut. The competition offers two main routes—the short “Zaeka” and the long “Cherni Vrah”—which start at 09:17. This winter sports event attracts ski and snowboard enthusiasts, offering challenging courses in a mountain setting. Participants can enjoy Vitosha’s beautiful scenery and mountain air.
course_highlights: “Zaeka” course – short course
“Cherni Vrah” course – long course
Held in Vitosha Nature Park, around Aleko Hut

name: Национален крос "По стъпките на Васил Левски" 2026
location: Garden next to National School of Applied Arts “Prof. Venko Kolev”, Troyan, Bulgaria
description: The National Cross-Country Race “In the Footsteps of Vasil Levski” is an annual event honoring the memory of the Apostle, with participants covering part of the route he once traveled. The race takes place in Troyan, starting near the garden by the Prof. Venko Kolev National School of Applied Arts. Several distances of varying difficulty and elevation are offered for different age and gender groups. The event combines sporting spirit with historical remembrance and is open to anyone wishing to honor Vasil Levski’s legacy.
course_highlights: Distances: 3 km, 8 km, and 12 km, with elevation gains ranging from 10 m to 375 m
The course follows paths traveled by Vasil Levski
The start is near the garden by the Prof. Venko Kolev National School of Applied Arts in Troyan
additional: Registration is open until 09.02.2026. Members of the Bulgarian Orienteering Federation submit entries at https://orienteering.bg, while those who are not registered can submit entries by email or phone. Bib numbers can be collected from the secretariat by 11:00, and on-site registration is possible until 10:30 if bib numbers are available. The youngest participants (3 km) are transported by minibus to the starting point and run along red markings. The Masters start (12 km) is at 11:20, following yellow markings. For the 2026 edition, the start is listed at 11:00 from the garden near the Prof. Venko Kolev National School of Applied Arts in Troyan; advance entries are accepted, and on-site registration is possible if bib numbers are available. The date listed in the 2026 sources is 14 February, not 20 February 2027.

name: ДЛШ КОЛОКРОС, КУПА ДОЛЧИНИ
description: Bulgarian Cyclocross Championship, Dolcini Cup is a cyclocross race held in Borisova Gradina, Sofia. The event is part of the Bulgarian Cycling Federation championship and offers participation opportunities for various rider categories. The race starts at 09:30, and detailed information and regulations are available on the federation’s official website. Registration is online via a special link provided by the organizers.
course_highlights: Race in Borisova Gradina, Sofia
Part of the Bulgarian Cycling Federation championship
Various participant categories

name: OPPENING SEASON Ultra Trail Run&XCM Cycling 2027
OPENING SEASON-награден фонд 3 000 € Ultra Trail Run&XCM Cycling
location: Clearing above the Rakiya Kazan, Ayazmoto Park (Metropolitan Methodius Kusev Park), Stara Zagora, Bulgaria
organizer: Клуб по колоездене и туризъм „Сърнена гора“
description: OPENING SEASON 2027 is the fourth anniversary edition of the iconic race in Stara Zagora, opening the sports season with a record prize pool of €5,000. Organized by the Sarnena Gora Cycling and Tourism Club with the support of Stara Zagora Municipality, the event features Ultra Trail Run and XCM Cycling disciplines. The race offers a variety of distances with different difficulty levels and course markings, following scenic routes through Mitropolit Metodiy Kusev Park (Ayazmoto).
course_highlights: Dynamic 5 km course within the park, marked in white
Moderately challenging 11 km distance with yellow markings and moderate elevation gain
The royal 42 km distance, marked in orange and featuring the challenges of the Sarnena Gora
additional: Registration and collection of race packs and numbers with timing chips from 06:30 to 08:30. Technical briefing before the start. Cycling (XCM & E-Bike) starts at 09:00; running races at various distances (5, 11, 21, 34, 42 km) start at 09:30. Grand awards ceremony at 17:00. Routes are marked with different colors for each distance. The start and finish are on the meadow above the rakia still. According to the published schedule, registration is from 06:30 to 08:30, cycling starts at 09:00, and running starts at 09:30.

name: Danube 24h Run 2026
description: Danube 24h Run is an ultramarathon held in the city of Ruse at the City Stadium. Participants can choose between the 24-hour, 12-hour and 6-hour events, or a 3 x 2-hour relay. The event offers an endurance challenge and is suitable for runners with different levels of fitness.
course_highlights: Ruse City Stadium is the start and finish venue
Individual running and relay options
Events of different durations: 24 hours, 12 hours, 6 hours and a relay
additional: For the 2026 edition, the 24-hour and 6-hour runs are scheduled to start on March 28 at 11:00, the 12-hour run at 23:00, and the relay on March 29 at 06:00. The race date listed in the metadata differs from the dates on the edition pages.

name: Plovdiv Hills in Markovo
organizer: Спортен клуб по планинско бягане и туризъм „Пловдив и Родопа“
description: Plovdiv Hills in Markovo is a mountain running race held in the foothills of the Rhodope Mountains around the village of Markovo, Plovdiv Province. The race offers four distances—8, 12, 22, and 44 km—as well as a 700-meter children’s course. Participants can enjoy well-marked and secured courses with aid stations providing water, food, and drinks. Race services include timing, electronic results tracking, medical assistance, and special race packs with gifts. The event is held under the auspices of Markovo Town Hall and organized by the Plovdiv and Rhodopa Mountain Running and Tourism Sports Clubs.

name: Велинград Ултра
description: Velingrad Ultra is the inaugural edition of an ultramarathon offering three challenging courses in Velingrad, the spa capital of the Balkans. Participants can choose between 11 km, 27 km, and 43 km mountain courses with varying elevation gain, passing through picturesque natural landscapes. The event includes professional organization, marked courses, aid stations, and medals for all finishers. It is an opportunity to immerse yourself in the magic of the mountains and enjoy sport and nature together.

name: Tarnovo Ultra 2026
location: Parking at Boris Denev Art Gallery, Assenevtsi Monument, Veliko Tarnovo, Bulgaria
distance_verbose: 50 km, 50 km, 35 km, 32 km, 25 km, 14 km

name: ZARA ULTRA TRAIL RUN & XCM CYCLING / Великденски Маратон 2026
organizer: СНЦ Клуб за колоездене и туризъм „Зарата“
price_range: от €14 до €31, в зависимост от категорията и датата на регистрация

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Втора такса на 5 км 16€ от 16.02 до 01.03.2026г.

description: ZARA ULTRA TRAIL RUN & XCM CYCLING / Easter Marathon 2026 is a sporting event in Stara Zagora featuring trail running and mountain biking. Organized by the Zaratа Cycling and Tourism Club Association, with the support of Stara Zagora Municipality and TD Sarnena Gora, the competition offers various running and cycling distances in Ayazmoto Park. Participants must have valid insurance and sign a liability waiver. The event begins with registration and briefing from 07:00 to 08:00, and the awards ceremony is at 17:00.
course_highlights: Trail running and mountain biking in Ayazmoto Park
Running distances: 5 km, 11 km, 21 km, 32 km and 38 km (ultra)
eBike MTB cycling at up to 27 km/h on the 38 km ultra course
additional: Registration and race-number pickup from 07:00 to 08:00. Cyclists must wear helmets. Payment is accepted only by bank transfer or at an EasyPay counter after online registration. Participants must have valid accident insurance for the day of the event (except UCI card holders). Awards ceremony at 17:00 for both disciplines. The cycling courses will include an approximately 32 km hobby course and a 42 km ultra course; online registration, payment by bank transfer; valid insurance and helmets are required for cyclists.

name: Турнир ”Цветанка Христова”
description: The Tsvetanka Khristova Tournament is an annual athletics competition held in memory of one of Bulgaria’s greatest track and field athletes. The competition is being held for the 17th time and includes the second round of the “A1 Athletics for Youth” series for young athletics talents. The tournament takes place at the Vasil Levski National Stadium in Sofia and brings together athletes of various ages and disciplines. It is an important event in Bulgarian athletics that honors Tsvetanka Khristova’s legacy and encourages the development of young talent.

name: Антеа рън
description: Antea Run is a unique race combining 23 km of running with natural and artificial obstacles in the scenic area around Sozopol. It’s not just a marathon, but a challenge for anyone who wants to push their limits and enjoy beautiful nature and varied terrain. The event attracts running and adventure enthusiasts looking for something more than an ordinary race.
course_highlights: 23 km of running with natural and artificial obstacles
Scenic area around Sozopol
A combination of running and overcoming challenges

name: Асеновградски Баири
description: Asenovgrad Hills is a race and festival that combines sport and outdoor fun in Asenovgrad and the Rhodope Mountains. The event includes mountain running and cycling, held on two separate days, allowing participants and guests to enjoy the region’s nature and attractions. Organized by the Asenovgrad Hills Association, the race offers various distances for runners and cyclists, suitable for different ages and fitness levels. Participation requires good physical fitness and appropriate equipment. The event is aimed at people who love sport and nature.

name: Национален шампионат 10 000м - писта
description: The National 10,000m Track Championships in Hisarya is a prestigious competition organized by the Bulgarian Athletics Federation. The championship brings together Bulgaria’s best athletes to compete over the classic 10-kilometer distance on the track. The event is part of the federation’s 2026 sports calendar and highlights the traditions and development of athletics in Bulgaria.

name: Студентско бягане "UNIRUN"
description: UNIRUN is a student running event in Sofia that connects sport with a social cause, supporting youth sports and cage-free shelters. The event takes place in West Park and offers four distances of varying difficulty, from 1 km to a half marathon of 21 km. Participants join a community that inspires movement, healthy living, and social engagement, while enjoying music, games, and prizes. The run is accompanied by festival activities and opportunities for personal development and social connections.

name: Pancharevo Trail Marathon
description: Pancharevo Trail Marathon is the largest spring mountain running event in Bulgaria, held near Pancharevo Lake. The race offers three distances: a 42 km marathon with 1,700 m of elevation gain, a 21 km half marathon with 700 m of elevation gain, and a 10 km route suitable for beginners, as well as a 15 km mountain hike. The routes pass through the scenic Lozen Mountain, with views of Vitosha, Stara Planina, Rila, and Iskar Reservoir. The event is organized by the Begach sports club and attracts more participants every year.

name: XL kmrun - Банкя
description: XL Bankya is a new race on the XLkmrun calendar, held in the foothills of Lyulin Mountain near Sofia. The course is shaped like a figure eight, starting on the northern outskirts of the town of Bankya and heading toward Ostrа Chuka Peak. Participants can choose between two distances: 6.4 km with 217 m of elevation gain, or 12.8 km. The course offers challenges for mountain-running enthusiasts. The race is part of the XLkmrun series, which includes a variety of courses and distances in Sofia and other cities.

name: Бистрица Вертикал Рън
description: Bistritsa Vertical Run is a scenic and challenging race that starts in the village of Bistritsa, which is accessible by public transport. The route crosses varied terrain with gradual but demanding climbs, reaching the Kikish area, which offers panoramic views of Sofia. The course continues to Kamen Del Hut, where participants can refuel with food and drinks. This race is an excellent strength and endurance workout, suitable for preparing for long distances and running in mountain conditions.

name: НШ по планинско бягане - изкачване за мъже и жени и юноши и девойки под 20 г.
description: The National Mountain Running Uphill Championship for men, women, and under-20 boys and girls takes place on April 26, 2026, in Bistritsa village, Sofia. The competition is part of the Bulgarian Athletics Federation calendar and offers a challenging uphill mountain race for different age groups. The organizers provide official registration and support for competitors, with communication handled directly with them. The event is a tradition and attracts athletes seeking a competitive experience on mountain terrain.

name: MaricaRUN
description: MaricaRUN 2026 is a unique sporting event featuring 5 km and 10 km distances, as well as a 1 km children’s run, held in the beautiful Maritsa Park in Dimitrovgrad. The race combines sport, excitement, and a charitable cause, with 40% of entry fees donated to charity. The course is flat, suitable for everyone, and passes through the most beautiful parts of the park, with views of the Maritsa River. Participants will enjoy a well-organized route with refreshment stations and a festive atmosphere featuring prizes and sports demonstrations.

name: Коджа Кая
description: Kodzha Kaya is Bulgaria’s first fully autonomous ultramarathon, held in the village of Bilka, in the Kodzha Kaya Peak area. The race offers various distances with substantial elevation gain and no aid stations, making it a true test of endurance and skill. Participants are challenged to finish before sunset while enjoying breathtaking views and natural beauty. This event is for lovers of adventure and mountain running, and leaves memories to last a lifetime.

name: МарицаРън 2026
description: Maritsa Run 2026 is a professionally organized race suitable for both beginners and experienced runners. The event offers three distances: 1 km for children up to 14 years old, 5 km for a fun sporting challenge, and 10 km for a greater personal achievement. The course passes through the most beautiful parts of Maritsa Park in Dimitrovgrad, including its paths, the river, the relaxation area, and art installations. Participants can enjoy a great atmosphere with music, spectators, and support along the route, as well as prizes and recognition, with a prize fund of over €1,500.

name: Mechi Chal Trail Chepelare
description: Mechi Chal Trail is an exciting mountain race taking place on May 3, 2026, in Chepelare, at Olympic Square. The courses follow mountain routes and forest trails in the Rhodope Mountains, suitable for both beginners and experienced trail runners. The race offers three distances with different elevation gains, challenging participants with true mountain terrain. Every finisher receives a medal, and the winners receive cash and merchandise prizes.

name: НШ по планинско бягане - изкачване и спускане мъже и жени, под 20 г., под 18г., под 16г.
description: The National Mountain Running Championship—uphill and downhill—for men and women, as well as under-20, under-18 and under-16 boys and girls, takes place in Chepelare. The competition offers challenging mountain terrain that tests participants’ endurance and skills. It is an important event in the Bulgarian athletics calendar, attracting both young and experienced runners. The organizers provide professional event management and support for all participants.

name: Sri Chinmoy Run and Become Marathon
10 дневно състезание „Шри Чинмой“
description: The 10-day Sri Chinmoy race in Sofia is the first certified multi-day race in Bulgaria and takes place in St. Peter and Paul Park. The race is run on a flat, certified 785-meter asphalt loop, with each participant competing to cover the greatest possible distance over 10 days. The event is organized with attention to detail, including official lap counting and strict rules for fairness and safety. Participants can enjoy the atmosphere of the race village and the support of the organizers and fellow runners.

name: РЕКОРД НА ХАЙДУШКАТА ПЪТЕКА 2026
location: Sinite Kamani Nature Park, Sliven, Bulgaria
description: The Haidushka Path Record 2026 is an annual race held in Sinite Kamani Nature Park near Sliven. Participants race up the iconic trail from its starting point to the large fountain by Karandila Hotel. The route offers different variations of varying difficulty. The race is for prestige, with no categories or prize money; results are officially recorded and published for every participant who completes the climb in under 1 hour. It is a unique challenge for mountain-running and nature enthusiasts.

name: ЮНАШКИ ИГРИ 2026
location: Сините камъни Nature Park, Sliven, Bulgaria
description: Yunashki Games 2026 take place in the Sinite Kamani Nature Park near Sliven on May 6, in honor of the birthday of Hadji Dimitar and St. George’s Day—the Day of Courage. The event celebrates the traditions and spirit of the haiduks, featuring games and competitions in which they tested their strength when choosing a voivode. The course and atmosphere are connected to the region’s historical heritage and the natural beauty of Sinite Kamani. The event is organized by the Old Elm Foundation, which works to preserve Sliven’s cultural heritage and nature.

name: Международен турнир за юноши и девойки под 18 г. „Младост”
description: The “Youth” International Tournament for boys and girls under 18 is held at the City Stadium in Ruse. This event has a rich tradition and brings together young athletes from various countries to compete in a range of track and field disciplines. The tournament supports the development of youth sport and gives talented athletes under 18 the opportunity to compete. The organizers emphasize the importance of registered performances for participation in certain disciplines, such as the girls’ long jump.

name: Трън Ултра Рън
description: Tran Ultra Run is an ultramarathon mountain-running event held in the picturesque Kraishte region, based in the village of Turokovtsi, Tran Municipality. The event offers four courses of varying distances and elevation gains, passing through the Rui, Ezimir, and Greben mountains, with numerous panoramic views and varied terrain ranging from soft trails to rocky sections. Organized by the Tran Tourist Association with the support of Tran Municipality, the event is suitable for mountain-running enthusiasts seeking a challenge and beautiful scenery.

name: Alpinist TRI
description: The Climbing Triathlon “New Life for the Alpinist Hut” is a unique competition that replaces classic swimming with a vertical challenge. It takes place around the Alpinist Hut and the village of Basarbovo, Ruse, and includes three disciplines: MTB cycling, running, and a final Via Ferrata climb. The competition can be entered individually or as a two-person relay, and all funds raised go toward restoring the hut. It’s an opportunity to test your strength against nature and support a worthy cause in one of the most beautiful areas of the Polomie region.

name: Amusnet Charity Run 2026
description: Amusnet Charity Run 2026 is a trail run with a cause, held in the area of the village of Zheleznitsa, near Sofia. The course is just over 5 km long and offers varied terrain, including a beautiful forest trail, a challenging climb, and a final descent. The event is open to everyone, whether you want to run or walk. The main goal is to take part and support the National Paralympic Federation. For every kilometer covered, Amusnet donates €5 to support the cause, which helps Bulgarian athletes with disabilities.

name: Tran Ultra Run
description: Tran Ultra Run is a mountain race held in the picturesque Kraishte region, based in the village of Turakovtsi, Tran Municipality. The race offers four courses of varying distances and elevation gains, passing through the Ruy, Ezimirska, and Greben mountains, with numerous peaks and panoramic views. The courses are loop routes with varied terrain, including soft trails, rocky sections, steep slopes, and forest areas. Organized by the Tran Tourist Society with the support of Tran Municipality, the race provides course marking, aid stations, and medical assistance for participants.

name: Elenovo Trail Run 2026
location: село Еленово, местност "Кара дере", община Нова Загора, област Сливен, Bulgaria
organizer: Народно читалище "Светлина-1908" и Община Нова Загора
price_range: до 12 април - по-ниска цена, след това - по-висока
description: Elenovo Trail Run is a new trail-running event in Nova Zagora Municipality, Sliven Province. The race takes place in the scenic Kara Dere area near the village of Elenovo, with varied courses suitable for runners of different levels. The event is part of the regional folklore festival and offers a unique opportunity to combine sport and nature with local traditions. The organizers provide GPX files for the courses to help participants prepare.
course_highlights: Courses of 4 km, 10/11 km, and 20/21 km on mountainous terrain
The Kara Dere area, with scenic views and natural beauty
Held as part of a folklore festival with a rich cultural program
additional: GPX files for the courses are available to download and use for preparation. The event takes place in an area with the Kara Dere reservoir. The organizer is the Nova Zagora Tourist Information Center, with coordinator Daniel Yordanov. The courses are available as downloadable GPX files; the event includes various routes and cultural activities in the Kara Dere area.

name: Sunrise Ultra
description: Sunrise Ultra is a challenging race along the rugged cliffs of Bulgaria’s northern coast, offering three distances: 42 km, 17 km, and 7 km. The race passes through iconic natural and cultural landmarks in the municipalities of Kavarna and Shabla, combining endurance with the beauty of the seascape. Participants receive a special T-shirt and medal inspired by the sunrise and the vastness of the sea, symbolizing the spirit of the event. It is a unique experience for nature and running enthusiasts seeking adventure and inspiration.

name: Wings for Life
description: Wings for Life World Run is a unique global race for runners and wheelchair participants, taking place on May 10, 2026, in Borisova Gradina, Sofia. Instead of a traditional finish line, competitors run until they are caught by the virtual “Catcher Car,” which starts 30 minutes after the beginning and gradually increases its speed. The event raises funds for spinal cord research, with 100% of entry fees and donations going to this cause. Participants can gather at the popular “The Sun” spot in Borisova Gradina and take part through the Wings for Life World Run mobile app.

name: XL kmrun - Плана
description: XL Plana is a trail race and part of the XLkmrun calendar, organized by 5kmrun. It takes place near the village of Plana, close to Sofia, in the Plana Mountain. Participants can choose from three distances—5.5 km, 11 km, and 16.5 km—which cross open terrain with varied conditions, including wet and sunny sections. The race is suitable for mountain-running enthusiasts seeking a challenge in a natural setting.

name: Луковит рън
description: The Lukovit Run road race is an annual 8.8-kilometer event that starts in the center of Lukovit and finishes at Prohodna Cave. The race attracts runners of different ages and abilities, with past winners including Ismail Senandzhi and Marinela Nинеva. The event is part of the Municipality of Lukovit’s sports calendar and offers a mass start over 800 meters for younger participants. The course is scenic and challenging, combining urban and natural surroundings.

name: Мемориал „Веселин Даскалов”
description: The Veselin Daskalov Memorial is a traditional athletics competition held in Lukovit, Bulgaria. The jubilee 20th edition took place at the city stadium, with more than 200 athletes from across the country competing in various distances from 100 m to 1500 m. The competition attracts both children and national-level athletes, providing opportunities for young talents and established competitors to showcase their skills. The organizers hold an official awards ceremony attended by local representatives and sports figures.

name: Маратон "Розова долина" - Rose Valley Marathon
description: The Rose Valley Marathon in Kazanlak is a sporting event for running enthusiasts of all levels. Its main goal is to encourage physical activity and introduce participants to the beauty of Bulgaria’s Rose Valley. The race offers three distances: a classic marathon of 42 km, a half marathon of 21 km, and a 10 km race. The start and finish are in Rosarium Park, in front of the Museum of Roses in Kazanlak. The course passes through the city, along cycling paths, and on secondary roads, with around 100 meters of elevation gain. The event takes place on May 10, 2026, at 09:00 and offers refreshment stations every 5 km, as well as awards in various categories.

name: СТЕНАТА RUN 2026
description: STENATA RUN 2026 is a race held near the Shumen Reservoir in the city of Shumen. The event offers various distances and formats, including individual and relay runs lasting from 1 to 6 hours. The course is suitable for runners with different levels of fitness and goals, combining natural beauty with challenges. The organizers, Shumen Early Runners, invite you to take part in this dynamic and friendly race.

name: Business Run Varna
description: IHB Business Run Varna is the largest team-building race in Bulgaria, held at the BulYard shipyard and Bulport Logistics in Varna. It is a relay race for teams of four, with each participant running 4 km before passing the baton to the next runner. The event combines sporting spirit and corporate teamwork, bringing together many companies and their employees in a dynamic, friendly format. In addition to the main race, there is also a Kids Run for children aged 4 to 12, supported by certified coaches.

name: ApriltsiRun
location: Априлци, Община Априлци, гр. Априлци, кв. "Острец, ул. "Цанко Дюстабанов" 12
organizer: Община Априлци, Сдружение „Троян в бъдещето“, НД „Традиция“ – 34-ти Пехотен Троянски полк
description: ApriltsiRun is a mountain race inspired by the heroic events of the April Uprising of 1876. The race follows historic trails around Maragidik Peak and Botev Peak, along which the insurgents traveled 150 years ago. The courses offer varying levels of difficulty, suitable for both professionals and mountain-running enthusiasts. The event combines sport, nature, and history, marking the anniversary of the uprising with panoramic routes and a charitable cause.

name: Маратон Варна
description: Varna Marathon is one of the most exciting sporting events in the maritime capital, combining challenge, emotion, and unforgettable moments. The course runs along Varna’s beautiful coastline, offering fresh air and picturesque views of the sea. The event attracts both local and international athletes, creating an atmosphere of sporting passion and support. Varna Marathon is a test of endurance and strength of spirit that inspires participants to achieve new personal goals.

name: Маратон на приятелството Плевен
description: The Friendship Marathon Pleven is a traditional event taking place on May 17, 2026, in the center of Pleven. The race includes a marathon, half marathon, 10.55 km race, relay, and the Vidas Run Kids children’s marathon. The certified courses pass through scenic parts of the city and Kaylaka Park. The event combines sport with a charitable cause supporting medical students. Organizers provide aid stations, medical services, and a full program for race day.

name: Спици и Бодли 2026
description: Spokes and Thorns 2026 is a cross-country mountain biking and duathlon event held at the foot of the Stara Planina Mountains near Kazanlak. The event offers routes of varying difficulty, suitable for both beginner and advanced cyclists. In addition to the sporting competition, participants and guests can enjoy a festival featuring live music, outdoor cinema, yoga, horseback riding, and other activities. The event combines sport, entertainment, and community in an unforgettable atmosphere.

name: Маратон Каланджа
description: Kalandzha Marathon is a celebratory event marking 10 years since its inception in 2026. It takes place in the village of Sinemorets and offers mountain running distances of 42, 21, 13 km, and 3 km for children, as well as mountain biking distances of 42 and 21 km. The courses pass through the scenic routes of Strandzha Nature Park, bringing together sport, nature, and community. The event includes race packs, an awards ceremony, and a party, creating a festive atmosphere for participants.

name: DECATHLON Thracian Ultra
description: DECATHLON TRAKIA UTRA is a mountain running event that recreates the spirit of the ancient Thracian lands through the magic of nature and sport. The race offers a variety of distances suitable for beginners, advanced runners, and experts, including ultralong courses with stunning views and challenges. It is an event that combines sporting spirit, history, and a love of nature, creating an unforgettable experience for all participants. Join us and discover the magic of Thrace in the heart of the Rhodope Mountains.

name: Мемориал "Йорданка Аризанова"
description: The “Yordanka Arizanova” Memorial is an annual competition dedicated to the memory of the legendary coach Yordanka Arizanova, who developed hundreds of accomplished athletes. The tournament is held at Plovdiv Stadium and includes events such as the 100 m, 200 m, 400 m, 800 m, and 400 m hurdles, in which the coach achieved her greatest successes. The competition brings together both young and established athletes to honor her legacy and contribution to Bulgarian athletics.

name: 7 Hills Run
description: 7 Hills Run is part of the RunBG Trail Series and takes place in the village of Zhelyava, Sofia. This is a challenging race that attracts mountain running and nature enthusiasts. The event offers a unique opportunity to enjoy beautiful landscapes and varied terrain in the Sofia area. The organizers provide professional organization and a friendly atmosphere for all participants.

name: Купа Мургаш 2026
description: Murgash Cup 2026 is the 17th edition of a mountain biking cross-country marathon (XCM) race held in the village of Zhelyava. The race offers three main routes of varying lengths and elevation gain, suitable for different categories of riders, including hobby riders and e-bikes. The routes pass through scenic and challenging terrain, including the famous Zhelyava Trail, which is popular with cyclists. The organizer reserves the right to make changes to the routes, and the event is suitable for intermediate and well-prepared cyclists.

name: Salomon Vitosha Trail
description: Salomon Vitosha Trail 2026 is a mountain race offering a unique experience in the wild nature of Vitosha. The race includes three distances of varying difficulty and elevation gain, suitable for both beginners and experienced runners. The start and finish are at Aleko Hut, and the courses cross varied terrain, including an ascent of Cherni Vrah—the highest point on Vitosha. The organizers aim to develop trail-running culture in Bulgaria and encourage an active lifestyle.

name: Национален шампионат под 18 г.
description: The U18 National Championships in Stara Zagora is a prestigious athletics competition organized by the Bulgarian Athletics Federation. The event brings together young athletes under 18 who compete in various track events. It is part of the national calendar and provides an opportunity for young athletics talents to compete and develop.

name: Rhodo Rock
description: Rhodo Rock is a remarkable ultramarathon held in the heart of the Rhodope Mountains, near the town of Momchilgrad. This unique sporting event brings together participants from around the world who love the challenges of mountain trails and the beauty of nature. The race offers a variety of routes featuring peaks, valleys, rivers, and forest trails, suitable for both professional athletes and outdoor adventure enthusiasts. Participants can look forward to an exciting experience and an atmosphere that combines sport and nature.

name: Business Run Sofia
description: Business Run Sofia is the largest team-building event in Bulgaria, bringing together employees from different companies for a corporate relay race. Teams have 4 participants, each of whom runs 4 laps of 1.2 km, for a total of 4.8 km. In addition to the relay, there are also a Power Walk, CEO Dash, and Kids Run. Every participant receives insurance, a medal, and gifts. The event is a great opportunity to strengthen team bonds and enjoy active recreation with colleagues.

name: Тепе Джамборе 2026 Tepe Jambore
location: Летен театър, Пловдив, Пловдивска област, България
description: Tepe Jambore is a sports and cultural marathon in Plovdiv, combining running, movement, and culture across the city center and its hills. The event offers a unique urban adventure with artistic and cultural performances, including jazz music, theater, and dance, turning running into a celebration of sport and culture. The routes pass through landmark city locations, hills, paths, and green spaces, and are suitable for all ages and fitness levels. This is not a standard race, but an experience that brings the community together and supports causes for people facing social disadvantage.
course_highlights: Champions’ Jambore — 13 km with 450 meters of elevation gain, passing over all of Plovdiv’s hills
Laid-Back Jambore — 7 km with 250 meters of elevation gain
Kids’ Jambore — 1 km in Bunardzhik Park, on a safe route in a supervised environment
additional: The event includes cultural stops featuring theater, music, dance, beer and wine with snacks, performers, and surprises. The start-finish area hosts a party with music and entertainment. Participants can volunteer with the Jambore Squad, helping support participants and the event organization. Corporate teams take part in a competition that celebrates team spirit and raises donations for the “Plovdiv112” volunteer formation. The routes include 13 km, 7 km, and 1 km options; the event is part of Plovdiv’s 2026 cultural calendar and offers entertainment for the whole family.

name: ДИВОТО ЗОВЕ МАДЖАРОВО 2026
description: Wild Calls Madzharovo is an annual event combining cycling and trail running in the scenic Eastern Rhodopes. It takes place in the town of Madzharovo, situated in the crater of an ancient volcano and surrounded by unique natural landscapes and historic landmarks. The courses offer a variety of distances and challenges suitable for both recreational and elite athletes. Organized by the Dimitar Madzharov Cycling Club, the event aims to showcase the region’s beauty and bring sports enthusiasts together in a spirit of adventure and respect for nature.
course_highlights: Trail running with up to 900 m of elevation gain and panoramic views of Botev Peak
Routes passing through dense forests and old trails, and near a waterfall
Unique natural scenery in a volcanic crater, close to the Arda River and its striking meanders
additional: Start and finish at the square in front of the Municipality in Madzharovo. Services include chip timing, mountain rescue, emergency medical assistance, a tasty lunch in the festival area, and the option to camp in the Arda River canyon or at a campsite in the town park. Multiple MTB, duathlon, and trail running distances; starts on June 13 and 14, 2026, including children’s races and eco activities.

name: Национален шампионат под 14г
description: The National Championship for under-14 competitors in Gabrovo is a two-day athletics event that brings together more than 300 young athletes from across the country. Held at Hristo Botev Stadium, it gives the youngest talents an opportunity to compete in classic track and field events. The competition is part of the Bulgarian Athletics Federation’s sports calendar and takes place alongside the international Nikola Valchanov Tournament. It is a significant event that supports the development of young athletes and promotes athletics in the region.

name: Турнир "Никола Вълчанов"
description: The Nikola Valchanov Athletics Tournament in Gabrovo is a traditional sporting event held at Aprilov Stadium. It features 17 events, including sprint races and shot put, for age groups ranging from under 14 to men and women. The organizers are Gabrovo Municipality, the Bulgarian Athletics Federation, and the TOT ATHLET athletics club. The event attracts both young and experienced athletes and opens officially at 11:00.

name: Отвъд Мостъ / Beyond the Bridge
description: Beyond the Bridge is a unique bike-and-run event in Lovech that combines a sporting challenge with historical and natural landmarks. Participants cross four iconic bridges and follow scenic routes that include the Devetashko Plateau, the Kakrina Inn, Hisarya Fortress, and the Bash Bunar and Stratesh parks. The event is suitable for both experienced athletes and beginners, with 20% of the fees going to a charitable cause. It’s an opportunity to enjoy nature and history and experience an unforgettable adventure.

name: Triglav Skyrun
description: Triglav Skyrun is a unique mountain race held in Central Balkan National Park, Bulgaria. The course passes three iconic mountain huts—Sokolna, Triglav, and Rusalka—and includes a climb to the third-highest peak in the Balkan Mountains, Golyam Kademliya (2,275.4 m). The race offers three distances of varying difficulty, all starting from the picturesque village of Tazha, the starting point for all three routes. This event is for lovers of mountain running and nature, combining challenge with the beauty of the wild mountains.

name: Бягай бос с усмивка
description: Run Barefoot with a Smile is a unique event held in picturesque Belogradchik. The course offers the opportunity to run barefoot, combining sport and enjoyment amid nature. The event is suitable for anyone who wants to experience the freedom and joy of running without shoes in beautiful, inspiring surroundings.

name: Зелените пирамиди 2026 - бягане и колоездене
organizer: Колездачен клуб „Берое“ и Творчески колектив „На улицата“
description: Green Pyramids 2026 is the third edition of a running and cycling event held in Bedечka Park and on the southern slopes of Sredna Gora near Stara Zagora. The event offers a range of distances for children and adults, including a trail half marathon, and is part of the “Na Zeleno” festival. The courses pass by the three ritual Thracian burial mounds known as the Green Pyramids and are suitable for different fitness levels. Participants receive a race pack with a race number and course support.
course_highlights: 21 km trail half marathon passing the three ritual Thracian burial mounds known as the “Green Pyramids”
Cross-country cycling routes of 21, 33 and 65 km near the city
Routes of varying difficulty, suitable for all fitness levels
additional: Participation is free for children up to 12 years old. The event is part of the “Na Zeleno” festival, June 19–21, in Bedечka Park. The 33 km route is ridden twice for the 65 km distance. The 33 km and 65 km routes are part of the Bulgarian Cycling Federation’s Bulgaria Cup, with different categories. The festival includes sporting competitions, workshops, music, cinema and food; a new location has been added—the Cypress Grove.

name: Национален шампионат
description: The XVI Bulgarian National Folklore Championship “Euro Folk 2026” takes place in Veliko Tarnovo, Bulgaria. This is a traditional event organized by the European Association of Folklore Festivals (EAFF), with the aim of preserving, developing, and promoting Bulgarian and European folklore through festivals and competitions. The championship includes various categories such as dance, choirs, songs, orchestras, and customs, with an emphasis on authentic and arranged folklore performances. The event is part of EAFF’s long-standing tradition and is held annually in the historic Bulgarian capital, Veliko Tarnovo.

name: PIRIN RUN
description: Pirin Ultra is a mountain ultramarathon held in Pirin National Park, a UNESCO-listed site. The race offers several distances for skyrunning and mountain-running enthusiasts, with impressive views and challenging terrain. Participants can enjoy a unique experience in Bulgaria’s natural surroundings, combining sport and adventure. The event takes place in Bansko and attracts runners from around the world.

name: XL kmrun - Парк Врана
description: XL Vrana is a race on the XLkmrun calendar, organized by 5kmrun and held in Vrana Park in Sofia. The course is well known and consists of a loop approximately 5 km long with minimal elevation gain. Participants can choose between three distances—short (5 km), medium (10 km), and long (15 km)—making it suitable for runners of different levels.

name: Шуменско плато 2026
description: Shumensko Plateau 2026 is a race taking place on June 21, 2026, in Shumensko Plateau Nature Park. The start and finish are near the Monument to the Founders of the Bulgarian State in the city of Shumen. Organized by Ilchov Bair Cycling Club, the event features cycling, eMTB, duathlon, and trail running. Participants compete on different courses and are required to follow safety and environmental protection rules. The race is suitable for enthusiasts of mountain biking and running in natural surroundings.

name: Крос-триатлон „По стъпките на траките“
description: The “In the Footsteps of the Thracians” cross triathlon is the inaugural edition of a race offering a unique experience in the mystical Valley of the Thracian Kings near Koprinka Reservoir, Kazanlak. Participants will take on challenging swimming, cycling, and running courses amid beautiful scenery and varied terrain. The event is suitable both for amateurs looking to test their strength and willpower and for those seeking outdoor fun. Organized by the Trayana-Triathlon Sports Club of Stara Zagora, the race promises unforgettable views and an atmospheric experience.

name: Витоша 100км
description: Vitosha 100 km is a mountain ultramarathon held around Vitosha Mountain in 9 stages, passing through picturesque villages and natural landmarks. The race offers a challenge for runners, cyclists, and duathletes, combining long distances with varied terrain. The organizers emphasize protecting nature and holding a zero-waste race. Participants receive race packs and special surprises, and the event is supported by local partners and sponsors.

name: Troyan Run
distance_verbose: 70 km, 69 km, Маратон, 28 km, 12 km, 5 km, 3000 метра
description: TroyanRun is a mountain race held in the Troyan Balkan, dedicated to the work of Vasil Levski. The race offers routes of varying difficulty, suitable for both professionals and mountain-running enthusiasts. It is organized by the “Troyan in the Future” association, which works to promote the area’s historical and natural heritage and encourage a healthy lifestyle through sport. The event also includes a street art festival and charitable initiatives.

name: Вършец ултра
description: Varshets Ultra is a mountain running event offering a variety of distances suitable for experienced ultrarunners, beginners, and children. The event takes place in the beautiful natural surroundings of Varshets, with the start in front of Hotel Medicus. Participants can choose between the 48 km ultra distance and shorter routes of 11.6 km, 5.9 km, and 1 km for children and beginners. The race combines sport, nature, and an opportunity for an active getaway in the national resort of Varshets.

name: Камчийски пясъци
description: Kamchiyski Pyasatsi is a unique running event taking place on July 4, 2026, along Bulgaria’s longest beach, between Kamchiya Resort Complex and Shkorpilovtsi. The course is entirely on sand and includes crossing the mouth of the Kamchiya River, with rescue equipment and assistance facilities provided. The race offers two main distances—10 km and 21.1 km—as well as a 2.2 km children’s run. It is organized by the Green Step club, which promotes a healthy lifestyle and adventure sports.

name: Вършец рън
description: Varshets Run and Varshets Ultra is a mountain running event offering a variety of distances suitable for experienced runners as well as beginners and children. The event takes place in the picturesque resort town of Varshets, with the start in front of the Medicus Hotel. The courses include a 48 km ultra distance, as well as shorter routes of 11.6 km, 5.9 km, and 1 km for children and beginners, offering opportunities for participants of different levels. Registration is through the runbulgaria.org platform, and race packs are collected at the Varshets Municipality.

name: Национален шампионат под 20 г.
description: The Under-20 National Championships, organized by the Bulgarian Athletics Federation, is a prestigious competition that brings together Bulgaria’s best young athletes. It takes place at a stadium in Sofia and offers young athletes an opportunity to develop and showcase their talents in athletics. The competition is part of the BAF’s 2026 sports calendar and is held under the auspices of Bulgaria’s leading athletics organization, which has a long-standing tradition and international recognition.

name: TRI Legend Batak 2026
description: TRI Legend Batak 2026 is a triathlon event taking place on July 11, 2026, at Batak Reservoir. The race offers three distances: Legend, Turbo, and Legend Relay, suitable for both experienced athletes and beginners. The course is marked and has aid stations, while the atmosphere is filled with camaraderie and challenge. This is a place where the race happens with you, not just for you.

name: XL kmrun - Сеславци
description: XLkmrun is an organized, non-professional athletics race over middle and long distances, offering a challenge for runners of varying fitness levels. The event takes place in Sofia and is part of the 5KM RUN initiative, which promotes a healthy lifestyle through free but organized running. It is an opportunity for anyone interested to take part in a sporting atmosphere that supports diversity and community.

name: Трявна ултра
description: Tryavna Ultra is an ultramarathon race offering challenging distances in the beautiful Balkan Mountains around the town of Tryavna. The event includes 100 km, 42 km, and 21 km races, as well as cycling routes and a duathlon. The courses feature varied terrain and numerous aid stations to ensure participants’ comfort and safety. The organizer is the iRun association, which has extensive experience organizing sporting events and building a sports community.

name: XCO National Championship 2026 (ДЛШ и ХОБИ)
location: Knyazhevska Gora Park, Knyazhevo, Sofia, Bulgaria

name: Балкан ултра
description: Balkan Ultra is a challenging mountain race held in the area around Pleven Hut, Apriltsi. The courses include technical sections with significant elevation gain and require good physical fitness and mountain experience. Participants can choose between two main distances—Sky and Ultra—each with a unique route through beautiful and demanding mountain terrain. The race offers impressive views and varied trails, including routes over peaks such as Botev and Mlechni Chal.

name: Магура Run
description: Magura RUN is a running event held near the village of Rabisha, Belogradchik, in northwestern Bulgaria. The event celebrates a love of movement and running, inviting all runners to take part regardless of their pace. The course offers a unique experience in nature, with the chance to run at both sunset and sunrise, combining sport with the beauty of the local landscape. The organizers, BG EVENTS AND GUIDING, put a great deal of effort and energy into creating an authentic and challenging event that may be the last of its kind because of changes in nature.
course_highlights: The course passes by Rabisha Lake and through the area around the village of Rabisha
The chance to run at sunset and sunrise
Held amid the scenic natural landscapes of northwestern Bulgaria
additional: The event is organized by BG EVENTS AND GUIDING, with an emphasis on authenticity and energy. Possible challenges in preparing for the event include finding workers to clear the course. The race takes place on July 27 and 28 near Rabisha Lake. No information is provided about start times, prices, or registration.

name: Национален шампионат под 23г.
description: The National U18 Championships is one of the largest competitions on the Bulgarian Athletics Federation’s sporting calendar. The competition includes a variety of events, with the discus and hammer events held at the National Sports Academy in Studentski Grad. Traditionally, the championships bring together young athletes from across the country, giving them the opportunity to compete at a high level and showcase their talent. The event is organized by the Bulgarian Athletics Federation.

name: Славееви Планини Ултра
distance_verbose: 50 km, 50 km, 33 km, 28 km, 16 km, 10 km
description: Slaveevi Planini Ultra 2026 is a trail running and mountain biking event held in the surroundings of the town of Dospat in the Rhodope Mountains. The event offers a variety of distances from 9 to 56 km, with different difficulty levels and up to 2,900 m of elevation gain. Participants can enjoy scenic forests, panoramic views, and fresh air, combining sport, adventure, and a love of the mountains. The start and finish are in the town center, and the race is suitable for both experienced runners and cyclists and enthusiasts looking for new challenges.
course_highlights: Distances from 9 to 56 km with up to 2,900 m of elevation gain
Route through scenic forests with panoramic views
Start and finish in the center of Dospat
additional: The race package includes a medal, a souvenir bearing the event logo, timing, a race number, course marking, photo coverage, and aid stations. Additional and mandatory equipment is not included. Registration at lower fees is available until April 30, 2026, 23:59:59; payment is due by May 2 at 12:00. Registration at early-bird fees is available until April 30, 2026, with medals, race packages, and aid stations included.

name: Национален шампионат по шосейни бягания
description: The first national road running championship in Bulgaria will take place in Plovdiv on August 1, 2026. The competition includes distances of 1 mile, 5 km, 10 km, and a half marathon, as well as races for children and beginners. The event is part of the Run Bulgaria series and offers a prize fund of over BGN 4,000. It is an important opportunity for recreational and professional runners to compete on attractive courses and prepare for European and world championships.

name: С ухание на малини и боровинки Run
description: With the scent of raspberries and blueberries, Run is an exciting trail running race held in northwestern Bulgaria, in the area around Midzhur Hut and Kopren Hut. Participants can choose from various courses with different difficulty levels and technical features, running amid breathtaking mountain views. The race offers adrenaline, new friendships, and a sense of accomplishment on every course. The organizers recommend wearing trail running shoes and remind participants that the race may be canceled in unfavorable weather conditions.

name: Green Heart Half Ultra Chepelare
description: Green Heart Half Ultra Chepelare is an event in the Bulgarian Half Ultra Challenge Series, held in Chepelare, in the Western Rhodope Mountains. The start and finish are at Olympic Square, at an altitude of 1,062 m. The routes pass through Rhodope forests, mountain meadows, and panoramic ridge trails, reaching a high point of 1,872 m. Participants can choose from three distances, which are the same for mountain running and mountain biking.

name: Balkaniada West
description: Balkaniada West is a mountain race taking place on August 2, 2026, starting at 06:00. The race includes several distances of varying lengths and elevation gain, with courses passing through scenic mountain areas around Gorski Rai Hut. The event has a limited number of participants, and applications to participate require prior approval. The organizers provide transportation, accommodation, and food, as well as branded clothing for those who finish within the cutoff time.

name: Мусала Екстрийм
description: Musala Extreme is a challenging mountain race held in Borovets, offering two distances: 38 km with 2,200 m of elevation gain and 16 km with 1,000 m of elevation gain. The course passes peaks such as Yastrebets, Aleko, Lyudmil Yankov, Musala, and Mancho, offering impressive views of the Rila, Pirin, Vitosha, and Stara Planina mountains. The race combines technically difficult sections with fast descents and demands strength, speed, and skill. Alongside the individual races, there is a team race, as well as the option to take part in a duathlon with cycling the following day.

name: Musala Extreme
organizer: Клуб за изкуство и спорт "Дунавска" / Borosport
description: Musala Extreme is a challenging mountain race in Borovets, Bulgaria, covering 38 km with 2,200 m of elevation gain. The course passes over peaks such as Yastrebets, Aleko, Lyudmil Yankov, Musala, and Mancho, offering impressive views of the Rila, Pirin, Vitosha, and Stara Planina mountains. The race requires technical skills for navigating rocky and steep sections, combining strength, speed, and care. The shorter Yastrebets Trail Run, covering 16 km with 1,000 m of elevation gain, is also held alongside it and is suitable for runners looking for an easier route. The organizers also offer a team race and a duathlon with cycling the following day.

name: XL kmrun - с. Кътина
description: XL Kătina is a mountain running event in the XLkmrun series, held near the village of Kătina, Sofia. The race offers three distances of varying lengths, suitable for different levels of fitness. The routes pass along natural trails and cart roads, offering a challenge amid beautiful scenery. The event is part of the XLkmrun series, which includes various mountain and park races in Sofia and other cities.

name: Хисаря рън
description: Hisarya Run is an annual race that attracts runners of different ages and abilities. The course starts and finishes at the modern Krepost Stadium and passes the preserved Roman fortress wall and two beautiful parks in Hisarya. The event offers two main distances: 7.85 km for more experienced runners and 1.6 km, suitable for children and teenagers. The event is part of RUN BULGARIA and combines sport with the region’s cultural and historical landmarks.

name: DECATHLON Persenk Ultra
description: DECATHLON Persenk Ultra is one of Bulgaria’s leading trail running races, held every summer in the heart of the Rhodope Mountains. The event brings together runners from around the world, who can enjoy the unique spirit, culture, and natural beauty of this ancient mountain region. The 50-kilometer course passes through some of the wildest and most beautiful parts of the mountains, including the Wonderful Bridges, the Chimneys, and Tsirikova Church, offering a challenge and unforgettable views.

name: Adventure Sky Run
location: Borovets, Samokov Municipality, Sofia Province, Bulgaria
description: Adventure Skyrun is a mountain race held in the Rila Mountains since 2016, offering three distances of varying difficulty and length. The courses pass through scenic locations such as Malyovitsa Peak, Musala Peak, Ribni Ezera Hut, and Strashnoto Lake. Participants can choose between a 12 km forest course, 25 km of ski trails, and a challenging 55 km run connecting the resorts of Borovets and Malyovitsa. The race offers stunning natural scenery and an opportunity to push beyond your limits.

name: Kom Epic Half Ultra Берковица
description: Kom Epic Half Ultra Berkovitsa is a mountain race in the Western Balkan Mountains and part of the Bulgarian Half Ultra Challenge Series. The race starts at Yordan Radichkov Square in Berkovitsa, at an elevation of 405 m, and the courses climb to Kom Peak (2,016 m), offering impressive views of the Danubian Plain, Rila, and the Rhodope Mountains. Participants can choose from three distances, which are the same for trail running and mountain biking. The event also includes a children’s race and a wide range of activities for children after the race.

name: Благотворителен турнир по уличен фитнес TroyanRun 2026
Teteven's Peaks
description: Teteven's Peaks offers an adventure for every mountain running and hiking enthusiast in the beautiful surroundings of the Teteven Balkan. The event features several distances: a challenging 27 km trail, a vertical climb, an easy 6 km route, and a guided mountain walk. Participants will enjoy fresh air, scenic views, and well-organized aid stations. The event is suitable for experienced runners, beginners, and families, with medals, T-shirts, and personalized bibs with timing chips provided.

name: Via Pontica
description: The cross-border Via Pontica Marathon takes place annually and offers a unique running experience through Bulgaria and Romania. Participants run along a scenic route past Lake Durankulak, the northern Bulgarian beaches, and the Romanian coastal settlements of Vama Veche and 2 Mai, crossing the border without stopping. The event includes distances of 28 km, 16 km, and a 2 km children’s race, with the finish on the beach near the village of Krapets. It is organized by the Green Step club, which promotes a healthy lifestyle and adventure sports.

name: Екиден маратон
description: Sofia Team Marathon is a relay race held on September 6, 2026, at the Vasil Levski National Stadium. The race promotes road relay running and marks the 140th anniversary of the Unification of the Principality of Bulgaria and Eastern Rumelia. Teams cover a total of 42.195 km, divided into six legs of different lengths, identified by color-coded numbers. The race is organized by Sports Club “Sport for All Sofia in Europe” and the Bulgarian Federation “Sport for All” to determine the national relay running champions.

name: Пирин ултра
description: Pirin Ultra is a mountain ultramarathon held in Pirin National Park, a UNESCO-listed site. The race offers a unique experience for skyrunning enthusiasts, with spectacular views and challenging routes of varying lengths. The event attracts runners from around the world, who compete across four distances through beautiful, wild mountain terrain. The organizers provide medical examinations and strict safety rules to ensure participants’ safety.

name: Чудобой 2026
description: Chudoboy is a team adventure race combining sporting disciplines with creative and intellectual challenges in nature in the village of Asparuhovo, Varna. The race offers three categories with different technical difficulty levels and course lengths—Elite, Hobby, and Ailyak—suitable for varying levels of fitness. Teams consist of two people, at least one of whom must be an adult. The race is aimed at adventure enthusiasts looking for both a competitive and adventurous spirit.

name: Шосеен пробег „Карнобат”
description: The Karnobat Road Race is a traditional athletics competition organized by Atlet Club (Karnobat) and Karnobat Municipality. The event includes various distances for men, women, and junior athletes, with the course passing through Third of March Central Square in Karnobat. It attracts athletes from different age groups and offers an opportunity for sports competition and the promotion of athletics in the region.

name: ELENA TRAIL RUN 2026
description: ELENA TRAIL RUN 2026 invites you to immerse yourself in the magic of the Elena Balkan with three challenging distances: 12 km for beginners and those who love speed, with panoramic views; 21 km with a balanced course combining technical sections and impressive scenery; and 33 km, combining the dynamic feel of the 12 km with the technical challenges of the 21 km. The event takes place on September 20, 2026, in the town of Elena, and promises autumn colors, fresh air, and unforgettable emotions for all participants. Registration is mandatory for everyone over 18, while younger participants have special participation terms.

name: XL kmrun - Кремиковци
description: XL kmrun - Kremikovtsi is an organized 5 km run held in Sofia. The event is part of the 5kmrun series, which takes place in several Bulgarian cities and is aimed at runners of all ages and ability levels. The start is at 9:00, and participation is free, making the event accessible and appealing to a wide range of runners. 5kmrun offers a friendly atmosphere and the opportunity to enjoy regular outdoor exercise.
course_highlights: 5 km road run
Held in Kremikovtsi, Sofia
Start at 9:00
additional: Participation is free. The event takes place weekly in several cities across Bulgaria. Special initiatives include 5kmrun FEST and children’s runs. It offers a friendly, supportive atmosphere for runners of all ages and ability levels.

name: K3 ULTRA – GOLD BORDER RACE
description: K3 ULTRA - GOLD BORDER RACE is the first ultramarathon to cover the border region of the Rhodope Mountains in Bulgaria. The race takes place in late September, when nature is at its most picturesque and colorful. Participants can enjoy professionally organized routes with minimal asphalt sections, marked and secured trails, and special support along the course. The event is a UTMB qualifier and awards points toward the ITRA ranking. All finishers receive a medal and a special race pack with a T-shirt and gifts.

name: K3 Ultra 2026
distance_verbose: 100 km, 60.9 km, Маратон, Полумаратон, 14 km, 5 km
organizer: Клуб за спорт и туризъм К3 Ултра
description: K3 ULTRA is one of the largest ultramarathons in Bulgaria, held in the picturesque Rhodope Mountains. The race offers five different courses of varying distances and elevation gains, all qualifying for the UTMB Index and earning points for the ITRA Ranking. Participants receive a race pack with a T-shirt, race number and gifts, and the courses are marked and secured, with minimal paved sections. The event provides medical assistance, aid stations with food and drinks, and professional race photography, creating an unforgettable experience in the magical Rhodope Mountains.

name: Поморие Рън / Pomorie Run
description: Pomorie Run is part of the RUN BULGARIA series and offers an attractive 10.25 km long-distance race and a 2023-meter short distance for beginners. The course follows the beach along the Black Sea and returns on a dirt road beside Pomorie Lake, combining sea views with natural beauty. The event is suitable for both experienced runners and newcomers, and children’s athletics activities for young talents take place before the race. Pomorie Run is a traditional event that attracts national champions and members of Bulgaria’s national team.

name: Чудобой сити 2026
location: Kovshak Cheshma, Aladzha Monastery area, Varna, Bulgaria

name: Международен шосеен пробег "Бягане на свободния дух Русе - Гюргево"
description: The international road race “Run for the Free Spirit Ruse–Giurgiu” is an annual event that brings together runners from Bulgaria and Romania for a race along the scenic route between the two cities. The race promotes sportsmanship and friendship between neighboring communities, offering a unique experience on the course. Participants can enjoy a well-organized event with international participation and support.

name: Държавно военно първенство по функционален фитнес 2026
Balkaniada
description: Balkaniada 2026 is a mountain skyrunning race held in the heart of Central Balkan National Park, near the city of Karlovo. The race offers challenging courses with impressive natural views and varied terrain, suitable for mountain runners and outdoor sports enthusiasts. After successfully hosting the 2025 Masters Skyrunning World Championships, Balkaniada is establishing itself as one of the leading mountain races in the Balkans. Participants can choose from several distances with varying lengths and elevation gain, offering a unique experience amid the wilderness.

name: Шосеен пробег „Варна”
description: The Varna Road Race is a traditional competition held in Varna’s Sea Garden, attracting some of the best runners in Bulgaria. The race includes various distances suitable for men, women, and young people, offering athletes from different age groups and clubs the opportunity to compete. The event is part of the sports calendar and promotes athletics in the region.

name: НАЦИОНАЛЕН УНИВЕРСИТЕТСКИ ШАМПИОНАТ ПО ЛЕКОАТЛЕТИЧЕСКИ КРОС – 2026
LIEBHERR Business Run Plovdiv
description: LIEBHERR Business Run Plovdiv is a corporate relay race and team-building event held at the LIEBHERR factory in Plovdiv. The race features teams of four, with each participant running 4 km by completing two laps of the flat 2 km course. It is the largest corporate run in southern Bulgaria, combining sport, fun, and charity. The event has been held in Plovdiv since 2017 and attracts companies from across the country.

name: Неофит Рилски маратон и колоездене 2026
description: Neofit Rilski Marathon and Cycling 2026 offers a unique adventure, with courses that pass through Bulgaria’s beautiful countryside from the village of Neofit Rilski to Ovech Fortress. The races include running and cycling at various distances, starting and finishing at Historical Park. Participants will face challenges with varying elevation gain and time limits, suitable for different fitness levels. A children’s run with treats is planned for kids. The event is suitable for sports and nature enthusiasts seeking a serious challenge and adventure.

name: НАЦИОНАЛЕН УНИВЕРСИТЕТСКИ ШАМПИОНАТ ПО ПЛАНИНСКО БЯГАНЕ 2026
location: Vitoshko Lale ski slope, Sofia, Bulgaria

name: Въстаниците на Стара Загора 2026
location: Park "Branitelite na Stara Zagora", Stara Zagora, Bulgaria

Нови Пазар Рън / Novi Pazar Run
Маратон "Хайдушки Пътеки"
location: Природен парк Сините камъни, Сливен, Bulgaria
distance_verbose: Маратон, Маратон, Маратон, Полумаратон, Полумаратон, 13 km, 12 km
organizer: КЛУБ СТОТЕ ВОЙВОДИ - ФОНДАЦИЯ СТАРИЯ БРЯСТ
description: The Haidushki Pateki Marathon is a unique race held in the Sinite Kamani Nature Park in the Balkan Mountains. The course passes through a historic rocky massif with alpine terrain, fortified with 14 ancient and medieval fortresses that outlaws used as refuges. The route follows ancient trails used by the outlaws and offers an opportunity to enjoy the area’s nature and history. The race takes place in the last week of October, bringing varied weather conditions and a different level of difficulty each year.

name: Black Sea Trail
description: Black Sea Trail is a mountain running event held in the Varna region of Bulgaria, with three different distances suitable for runners of various levels. The courses offer a variety of terrain and beautiful views of the Black Sea, combining challenging climbs and descents. The event is a great opportunity for nature lovers and mountain runners to enjoy sport and the outdoors together.

name: Emine ultra
description: Emine Ultra is a mountain running event that combines the beauty of the mountains and the sea in the Elenite area. The race offers four distances—4K, 12K, 28K, and 50K—suitable for runners of different levels. The course follows scenic natural trails and offers a unique experience in nature. The event is part of the international Kom–Emine route and attracts runners seeking challenge and inspiration.

name: 34-ти Мемориал „Митето”
description: The “Dimitar Varbanov - Miteto” race in the town of Koynare is a traditional athletics event with a history spanning more than 30 years. It includes half marathons, road races, and track meets. In recent years, a race walking competition has also been held, attracting athletes from cities across Bulgaria. The organizers, the Spartak - Koynare Athletics Club, provide professional organization and competitions for all ages. The event is known for featuring Bulgaria’s top runners and race walkers.

name: Надбягване в Източни Родопи
description: The Eastern Rhodopes race is an ultrarunning event held in the Krumovgrad area, known for its rich biodiversity and mystical history. The courses pass through unique natural phenomena and megalithic monuments, such as Sheytan Dere and Kovil, offering challenging technical descents and climbs. The race is suitable for both experienced runners and enthusiasts who want to enjoy the wilderness and adventurous spirit of the Eastern Rhodopes. The organizers provide course marking, medals, timing and photographers, and participants can also run with pets. The use of reusable water bottles is encouraged.
course_highlights: Courses pass by megalithic monuments such as Kovil and natural phenomena such as Sheytan Dere
Technical descents and climbs with moderate elevation gain
Pets are welcome, with water and treats available at the aid stations
additional: Course marking, medals, timing and photographers are provided. Participants can run with pets, with water and treats available for them at the aid stations. Reusable water bottles or cups are recommended to reduce plastic use. Courses: 67 km, 37 km, 22 km, 4 km; registration and participation with support for pets; environmental requirements.

name: Национален шампионат по крос кънтри
description: The National Cross Country Championship in Koynare is a prestigious competition that brings together athletes from across Bulgaria for challenging races in a natural and demanding setting. The event offers young and experienced runners the opportunity to compete on varied terrain suited to cross country. The organizers provide professional timing and live results, ensuring accurate and transparent rankings. The event is part of the Race Timing BG calendar, which offers modern registration and timing services.
course_highlights: Natural obstacles and varied terrain
Suitable for all age groups and fitness levels
Professional timing using RFID technology
additional: Online registration with personalized emails and a real-time participant list. Certified timing equipment is used, with live results optimized for mobile devices and computers. The date is 2026-10-24. The race will take place in Koynare, organized by Race Timing BG. The course is in the area around the town.

name: Балкански шампионат по крос кънтри
organizer: Балканска атлетика (АБАФ), атлетически клуб „Спартак“ – Койнаре, община Червен бряг
description: The 2026 Balkan Cross Country Championships will be held in Koynare, Bulgaria, on November 7. The event is organized by the local Spartak-Koynare Athletics Club in cooperation with the town hall, Cherven Bryag Municipality, and the Bulgarian Athletics Federation. The course is designed around the stadium and the athletics club buildings, near the town center, and will welcome more than 600 athletes and guests. Koynare is an established host of running competitions, with a long-standing tradition and experience in organizing sporting events.
course_highlights: The course is around the stadium and athletics club buildings in the center of Koynare
Several luxury hotels are available within a 20 km radius
Koynare has actively organized running events for more than 30 years
additional: More than 600 athletes, team representatives, referees, organizers, and fans are expected to attend. The event is part of the sports calendar of Balkan Athletics and the Bulgarian Athletics Federation. In late October 2026, Koynare will also host the national cross country championships as preparation for the Balkan Championships. The course is around the stadium and athletics club buildings, and hotels within a 20 km radius can accommodate more than 600 participants and guests.

name: The Cactus Run
description: The Cactus Run is one of the largest classic races in the RunBG Trail Series, held in the village of German, Sofia. The event offers a unique experience in nature, with varied courses suited to different levels of runners. The routes follow scenic trails and offer challenges that will appeal to both recreational and experienced runners. Organized by Trail Series, the race is part of a seasonal series that brings together runners from across the country.
course_highlights: Courses in the natural surroundings of the village of German
Scenic trails and varied terrain
Suitable for different levels of runners
additional: The event takes place on 8 November 2026, from 11:00 to 15:00, in the village of German. The organizer is Trail Series. Google Maps directions to the location are available. No specific prices or registration categories have been published on the pages at this time. A trail race on varied terrain, including asphalt and trails; registration details are not specified.

name: Първа Пушка Trail 2026
description: First Rifle Trail is a mountain running event in Koprivshtitsa that brings together sport, nature, and history. The race offers three routes of varying distances and elevation gain, passing through scenic forest trails and open ridgelines, and reaching Mount Bogdan—the highest point in Sredna Gora. Participants can enjoy beautiful autumn views, historic sites, and the atmosphere of the old town. The 25 km and 35 km distances are part of the international UTMB Index network, offering the opportunity to take part in the World Series.
course_highlights: Routes through scenic forest trails and open ridgelines
Climb to Mount Bogdan (1604 m), the highest point in Sredna Gora
Cobblestone streets and the historic atmosphere of Koprivshtitsa
additional: The start is at 20th April Square in Koprivshtitsa. The entry includes a race pack with materials and gifts, chip timing, insurance, and medical assistance. Children under 13 may take part in the 10 km distance only with an accompanying adult. In poor weather conditions, the 10 km course may be run in the opposite direction. The cutoff time for 25 km is 5 hours and 30 minutes, and for 35 km it is 6 hours and 30 minutes.
